trigger_or_context: You are with your partner, but you feel checked out, so you just do the usual day-to-day things.
short_term_function: Doing the motions keeps the relationship running as usual, so you don't have to stop and deal with what feels off.
developmental_cost: You stay side by side but not really together, so real closeness can't grow.
adaptive_alternative_1: When you notice you're on autopilot, pick one small moment to really show up. Name to yourself what you feel, then share one honest thing with your partner.
what_new_response_supports: You find out if real closeness can come back when you show up — or if the gap is bigger than a rough patch.
expected_discomfort_or_cost: Showing up for real can feel scary after being checked out, and what you learn may be hard.
context_conditions: A short tired stretch where you still show up is different from being checked out for a long time. This is about the long, settled kind.
review_reason: No Expansion competency cleanly maps to bringing authentic emotional presence; behavior is also borderline between Likely Maintains and Context Dependent.
